question: What range of reality must be encompassed when meditating on that object in each place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in each place.
The object of meditation is that entity.
Its scope extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate in each place on that entity as pervading the whole range from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on him in each place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci...
